metric: tyrosine-OH -> antigen main-chain bonds per 100 interface residues (zero-inflated)
interpretation: Full-set replacement for the n=45 holdout: with 411 cryo-EM and 460 X-ray structures the tyrosine-backbone rate is statistically indistinguishable (Mann-Whitney p=0.66; rank-biserial 0.02, 95% CI [-0.054, 0.088]), a far better-powered confirmation than the holdout (p=0.19). The small effect and a CI tight around zero support generalisation of the mechanism to cryo-EM structures.
